findings.observedBefore: Locators printed 'S1, PDF 71–83' with no statement of what a PDF page is.
findings.rootCause: formatSourceRef abbreviated the PDF locator; the registry holds no printed page numbers.

findings.reproducedAt: a306d825 production build, S1 and S19 lists at 1204x987, 1440x900, 1024x768, 390x844, 320x740, 100% and 200% root text
findings.observedBefore: Open list absolute z-index 5 under the sticky continuation z-index 10: overlap at every 100% size, last source's focused Copy covered at 1204/1440/1024/390; at 200% text and phone widths the list and its first source rose above the viewport under the site header. Not reproduced at 390x844 200% (bar far off screen).
findings.rootCause: The shared StageSourcesFooter floats its list up from the summary; this course scrolls the document and pins its continuation. Separately a fixed scroll-padding-bottom: 19rem (608 px at 200% text) left no focus band on short viewports.
findings.observedAfter: List in page flow after the lesson section: never intersects the bar at any matrix size; first and last source start below the header and hit-test as themselves; every focused control in the list is in view and uncovered; Escape closes and returns focus to the summary. Bottom scroll reserve = measured bar height + 12 px.
